Bagaimana alur dan tata cara mendaftar m: What is the procedure and flow for registering for an internship at Diskominfo Sleman?
Pendaftaran dilakukan secara mandiri ata: Registration is done independently or in groups via the MAGKOM portal: (1) Create a portal account, (2) Choose a field formation and implementation month that still has available quota, (3) Upload required documents (Institutional Cover Letter, CV, Proposal, and Transcript/Report Card), (4) Wait for admin verification.
Apakah siswa SMK dan mahasiswa perguruan: Do vocational school (SMK) students and college students have different requirements?
Secara umum sama, namun untuk siswa SMK: In general they are the same, but for vocational school students the application letter is signed by the Principal / Vice Principal for Industry Relations and includes parental consent, while university students attach an official cover letter from the Faculty/Department.
Apakah bisa mendaftar lebih dari satu bi: Can I register for more than one field or internship month?
Tidak. Setiap peserta hanya dapat memili: No. Each participant can only choose one field formation in one internship period to ensure fair quota allocation for all applicants.
Bagaimana jika tidak menerima email veri: What if I do not receive an account verification email?
Silakan periksa folder Spam atau Promosi: Please check the Spam or Promotions folder in your email. If it has not arrived within 15 minutes, you can request a resend of the verification link via the login page.
Apakah akun portal bisa digunakan untuk: Can the portal account be used to apply for the next period?
Akun Anda berlaku permanen di portal MAG: Your account is permanent in the MAGKOM portal. You can reuse it to view activity history or apply for the next period after the previous internship is completed.
Apakah ada kuis atau tes kompetensi saat: Is there a quiz or competency test during the selection process?
Beberapa bidang teknis seperti Aplikasi: Several technical fields such as Informatics Applications (Aptika) and Cryptography may include a basic competency test or short technical quiz to ensure suitability with the project to be undertaken.
Berapa lama proses verifikasi berkas ole: How long does the document verification process by the admin take?
Proses verifikasi dan kurasi berkas admi: The administrative document verification and curation process takes 1 to 3 working days after submission.
Apa saja fasilitas dan benefit yang dida: What facilities and benefits do internship participants receive?
Peserta mendapatkan bimbingan intensif d: Participants receive intensive guidance from professional Civil Servant Mentors, access to real government project modules, a real agency work portfolio, and industry-standard work experience.
Apakah program magang di Diskominfo Slem: Is the internship program at Diskominfo Sleman paid or salaried?
Program magang Diskominfo Sleman 100% GR: The Diskominfo Sleman internship program is 100% FREE (no fees charged) and is non-commercial without stipend compensation (unpaid government internship).
Apa saja kewajiban dari peserta magang?: What are the obligations of internship participants?
Peserta wajib: (1) Mematuhi jam kerja AS: Participants are required to: (1) Comply with Diskominfo Civil Servant working hours (Monday–Thursday 07.30–15.30 WIB, Friday 07.30–14.30 WIB), (2) Wear neat school/university uniforms and shoes, (3) Complete project assignments on time, (4) Fill in weekly logbooks with discipline, and (5) Maintain ethics and confidentiality of official agency data.

Dinas Komunikasi dan Informatika (Diskom: The Communication and Informatics Department (Diskominfo) of Sleman Regency is fully committed to protecting the privacy and security of personal data of prospective participants, active interns, and alumni of the internship program (MAGKOM). This policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal information.
Untuk keperluan seleksi administrasi, pe: For administrative selection, division placement, and official graduation determination, we collect data including:
Identitas Diri: Nama lengkap, NISN/NIM,: Personal Identity: Full name, NISN/NIM, National ID (NIK), place & date of birth, and official profile photo.
Kontak: Alamat surat elektronik (email): Contact: Active email address and telephone/WhatsApp number.
Afiliasi Akademik: Asal sekolah SMK/perg: Academic Affiliation: Originating vocational school/university, study program/major, and semester/grade level.
Dokumen Persyaratan: Surat pengantar res: Required Documents: Official cover letter from educational institution, proposal/curriculum vitae, academic transcript, and skill portfolio.
Seluruh berkas dokumen yang diunggah ke: All document files uploaded to MAGKOM system are stored on encrypted private storage. Documents cannot be accessed publicly without authorization.
Verifikator dinas dan pembimbing lapanga: Agency verifiers and field mentors can only access your files via temporary digitally signed links (signed URLs) with strict expiration times to prevent information leaks.
Pemerintah Kabupaten Sleman menjamin bah: The Sleman Regency Government guarantees that interns' personal data will never be traded, leased, or shared with commercial third parties. Data is used internally only for internship competence guidance and government agency performance reporting.
Anda memiliki hak untuk meminta pembarua: You have the right to request data updates, correct biographical errors, or consult regarding your document status via official channels:
Program Magang MagKom diperuntukkan bagi: The MagKom Internship Program is intended for active vocational students (SMK/MAK) and active university students (D3, D4, or S1). Candidates are required to attach an official cover letter from their educational institution and ensure all entered data is accurate and legally accountable.
Tata Tertib, Kehadiran & Jam Kerja Kedin: Rules of Conduct, Attendance & Official Working Hours
